Dodota has a number of factors including land that make it suitable for crop and livestock production. The altitude of this Woreda ranges from 1400 to 2500 meters above sea level. It is surrounded by water sources rivers including Awash river located at a distance of 40 kilometers, while Keleta river lies at the center of the Woreda. A survey of the land by the Regional State Government shows within the Woreda 23.2% of the total land is arable or cultivable, 10.6% pasture, 4.3% forest, and the remaining 42% is considered swampy, unusable mountainous area. Nearly, ______ million hectares of arable agricultural land exists within the district, which is considered potentially suitable for agricultural production. Characterized by small and fragmented land holding, out of the stated total land suitable for agriculture, only 43% percent of the arable land is utilized for agricultural cultivation annually. This shows that the Woreda’s potential arable land is underutilized.

집행한도액: 184,700 USD 본부 승인 된 사업예산 한도임 기존 사무소 원상복구: 10,000 USD 이전 사무소 마감공사: 116,000 USD 가구 구입 및 설치: 48,700 USD 이사비용: 5,000 USD 예비비: 5,000 USD 기초금액: 본부에서 승인한 집행한도액 중 예비비를 제외 한 179,700USD로 결정하고 입찰참여 업체가 투찰금액 산정 시 참고할 수 있도록 공개해야 하므로 입찰공고 및 입찰설명회에 공지함. 3) 예정가격: 계약을 체결함에 있어 낙찰자 및 계약금액의 결정기준으로 삼기 위하여 입찰 또는 계약체결 전에 미리 작성비치해 두는 가액을 말하며 미리 누설되지 않도록 함(비공개). 기초금액을 기준으로 복수예정가격을 작성하여 (입찰참여업체의)추첨을 통해 산술 평균하여 최종 예정가격을 결정하여 예정가격조서를 작성하고 개찰 시 공표함. * 예정가격산정 절차 ① 집행한도액 산정 → ② 기초금액 결정 → ④ 복수예비가격 작성 → ⑤ 예정가격조서 작성 → ⑥ 예정가격결정 4) 낙찰 하한율: 87.745% (10억원 미만 공사) . 5) 부가가치세(VAT) 면세관련 KOICA에서 지원하는 무상지원사업은 필리핀 정부가 세금을 면세하도록 되어 있으나, 본 사업은 무상지원사업이 아니고, VAT로 인한 혼란과 분쟁, 공사지연 등을 방지하기 위하여 VAT를 지급하고, 추후 필리핀 정부와 협의하여 VAT를 환급 받을 수 있도록 노력하고, 이 경우 협력업체는 KOICA에 반환하여야 함을 입찰공고 및 계약서에 명기함.

evidence_text: 20th August 2020 CONSTRUCTION OF PIPED WATER SUPPLY SYSTEMS IN TWO (2) PARISHES IN MITYANA DISTRICT - [KOICA/ESMV/2020/1] Korea International Cooperation Agency (KOICA) has allocated funds towards the implementation of the Project for Establishment of Sustainable Model Villages in Uganda and would like to use some of the funds to be used for the acquisition of Construction of Piped Water Supply Systems in two (2) parishes in Mityana District (Kikandwa and Bukooba parishes). The Entity invites sealed bids from eligible bidders for the provision of the above works. Bidding will be conducted in accordance with KOICA procurement guidelines is open to all bidders. Interested eligible bidders may obtain further information and inspect the bidding documents at the address given below at 8(a) from Monday to Thursday from 8.00 am – 4.00 pm and on Friday from 8.00 am – 12.30 pm. The Bidding documents in English may be obtained by interested bidders on the submission of a written application to the address below at 8(b). Bids must be delivered to the address below at 8(c) at or before 13th October 2020, 10:00am. All bids must be accompanied by a bid security in form of a bank guarantee of 2%

KOICA 는 당 입찰준비에 소요되는 경비 일체에 대한 책임이 없으며 모든 경비는 응찰자가 부담
